questions.question: What does the speaker mean by saying 2026 is 'the year of less'?
options: A) A year with fewer holidays
B) A year focused on reducing consumption and screen time
C) A year with less income
D) A year with fewer people in the world
questions.explanation: 在这段视频开头，说话者提到2026年是'the year of less'，结合视频整体内容（减少手机使用、少刷社交媒体、少消费），她指的并不是具体某件东西变少，而是一种生活理念——减少不必要的消费和屏幕时间，过更简约、更有质量的生活。

questions.question: According to the speaker, which abilities are affected by excessive phone use?
options: A) Cooking, cleaning, and driving
B) Reaction time, thinking time, and ability to hold conversation
C) Reading, writing, and arithmetic
D) Sleeping, eating, and exercising
questions.explanation: 在原文中，说话者明确提到：'Your like reaction time, your thinking time, your ability to like withhold conversation...' 也就是反应时间、思考时间以及与人持续对话的能力都受到了影响。这是过度使用手机/社交媒体的常见后果。

questions.question: What does the phrase 'skim over' mean in this context?
options: A) To read something carefully and thoroughly
B) To skip or glance through something quickly without deep focus
C) To memorize something by heart
D) To translate something into another language
questions.explanation: 'Skim over' 是一个常见的英语短语，意思是快速浏览、走马观花地看，没有深入阅读或理解。说话者在这里对比了'skim over'（快速浏览文章）和'sit down and read'（坐下来认真阅读），强调如今人们很难专注地完整阅读。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean by 'my brain just could not sit with something for a long period of time'?
options: A) She couldn't find a comfortable place to sit
B) She was physically unable to stay still
C) She couldn't focus on one thing for an extended period
D) She forgot things after sitting for too long
questions.explanation: 这句话中的'sit with something'是一种形象表达，意思是'持续专注在某件事上'。说话者用这句话表达自己因为频繁刷手机，导致大脑无法长时间专注于同一件事，注意力变得碎片化。

questions.question: What does the idiom 'a big red flag' mean in the context?
options: A) A literal red flag used as a warning sign at the beach
B) A sign or signal that indicates something is wrong or problematic
C) A celebration or festive event
D) A type of warning light on a car dashboard
questions.explanation: 'Red flag'（红旗）是英语中常用的习语，指警示信号，表示某事可能有问题或危险。说话者用'big red flag'来形容自己身体出现的不适症状（头疼），认为这是手机使用过度的警告信号。

questions.question: What physical symptom did the speaker experience as a result of excessive screen time?
options: A) Back pain
B) Headaches at the end of the day
C) Stomach problems
D) Blurred vision
questions.explanation: 原文中明确提到：'I also noticed I started getting headaches at the end of the day.'（我还注意到我开始在一天结束时头疼。）这是她意识到手机使用过度的一个身体信号。

questions.question: What does the speaker mean by 'over consuming' in this context?
options: A) Eating too much food
B) Spending too much money on shopping
C) Taking in too much content, especially through social media
D) Drinking too many beverages
questions.explanation: 在这段视频中，'over consuming'特指信息过载，特别是社交媒体上的内容消费过度。说话者用这个词来描述现代人不断地刷视频、看帖子，导致大脑超负荷运转的现象。

questions.question: What does it mean to 'set boundaries' with your phone?
options: A) To buy a new phone with restrictions
B) To establish rules or limits for when and how you use your phone
C) To draw lines on your phone screen
D) To give your phone to someone else to manage
questions.explanation: 'Set boundaries'（设定界限）是指为自己制定规则和限制。说话者提到她个人努力'set boundaries'（设定界限），也就是给自己制定手机使用的规则，限制使用时间和场景。

questions.question: What does the speaker imply by saying 'I thought I had discipline'?
options: A) She believes she has strong self-control in all areas
B) She realized her self-discipline wasn't strong enough to resist social media
C) She is very strict with her children
D) She exercises discipline every morning
questions.explanation: 说话者说'I thought I had discipline'，结合后文可知，她原本以为自己的自律能力足够强，但后来发现面对社交媒体的诱惑，自律并不够用。这是一种自我反思，承认自己高估了意志力。

questions.question: What does 'it was way too easy to just go back on social media' suggest?
options: A) Social media is very user-friendly
B) Returning to social media is highly addictive and hard to resist
C) Social media apps load very quickly
D) It's easy to delete social media apps
questions.explanation: 这句话表达了社交媒体极强的成瘾性——即使下定决心不用，也很容易就重新开始刷。'Way too easy'（太容易了）暗示这种诱惑难以抗拒，反映出社交媒体的成瘾机制。

questions.question: According to the speaker, what helps her get off her phone?
options: A) Watching more TV
B) Engaging in other activities (hobbies, etc.)
C) Buying a new phone
D) Taking sleeping pills
questions.explanation: 原文说：'This not only helps me get off of my phone, but I feel like I'm...'，结合上下文，她指的是培养兴趣爱好等活动，让自己不再依赖手机。这些活动让她有更多有意义的事情可做。

questions.question: What does the speaker recommend when trying to start a new hobby?
options: A) Buy all supplies separately from different stores
B) Find a kit that comes with everything you need
C) Watch YouTube tutorials first
D) Ask friends for recommendations
questions.explanation: 说话者建议初学者买套装（kit），比如针织套装（knitting kit）或刺绣套装（embroidery kit），因为套装里包含了所有需要的东西，'comes with everything you need'（包含所有你需要的东西），这样入门更简单方便。

questions.question: What is the main benefit of reducing phone usage mentioned in the video regarding family?
options: A) You will save money on phone bills
B) You will be more present with your family
C) You will have more time for vacations
D) You will eat healthier meals
questions.explanation: 原文中明确提到：'You'll be more present with your family.'（你会更专注于陪伴家人。）'Present'在这里不是'礼物'的意思，而是指'在场、专注、投入'，减少手机使用能让人更专注于与家人的相处。

questions.question: What does the speaker say about the impact on children?
options: A) Children will get better grades
B) You'll have more patience for your kids
C) Children will sleep earlier
D) Children will eat more vegetables
questions.explanation: 原文：'You'll have more patience for your kids.'（你对孩子会更有耐心。）说话者认为，减少手机使用能让人情绪更稳定、注意力更集中，因此在面对孩子时也更有耐心。

questions.question: What does 'long form media' refer to?
options: A) Short videos on TikTok
B) Extended content like full articles, documentaries, or books
C) Newspaper headlines
D) Social media posts
questions.explanation: 'Long form media'（长篇媒体内容）指的是篇幅较长、深入的内容形式，如长文章、纪录片、书籍等，与短视频或碎片化信息形成对比。说话者提到这一点是想对比当下'being fed something right after the other'（不断被投喂信息）和真正有深度的内容消费。

questions.question: Which relationships does the speaker mention being affected by social media habits?
options: A) Only friendships
B) Business relationships
C) Partner, spouse, and family relationships
D) Only online relationships
questions.explanation: 原文中提到：'how those things are also affecting your partner, your spouse, your...'，明确指出伴侣、配偶及家庭关系都会受到影响。这说明过度使用手机不只是个人问题，还会波及身边的亲密关系。

questions.question: What is the speaker's Level 1 challenge?
options: A) No social media on weekends
B) No scrolling between 5 p.m. and bedtime
C) No phone at dinner
D) Delete all social media apps
questions.explanation: 原文中明确指出：'Level one, no scrolling between 5 p.m.' 即从下午5点开始到睡觉前不再刷手机。这是一个相对容易的入门级挑战。

questions.question: What is the speaker's Level 2 challenge?
options: A) No phone at work
B) Phone-free Sundays
C) No social media for a month
D) No emails on weekends
questions.explanation: 原文中提到：'And level two, phone-free Sundays.'（第二级，周日无手机日。）这是比第一级更进一步的挑战，要求整天不碰手机。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest using to help stay off the phone?
options: A) A new expensive phone
B) An app blocker or a 'brick' (dumb phone)
C) A smartwatch
D) A tablet
questions.explanation: 原文中提到：'Get an app blocker, get a brick, get something that is making you off of [the phone]...' 也就是使用应用拦截器，或者换成只能打电话发短信的'砖头机'（dumb phone），强制自己远离智能手机。

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest doing during the 'no scrolling' time?
options: A) Watching TV
B) Working out before work, going for a walk, or pursuing hobbies
C) Playing video games
D) Sleeping all evening
questions.explanation: 原文中提到：'Maybe you start to work out before work or go for a walk, but keep [your time]...'，也就是用运动、散步等健康活动来填充原本刷手机的时间。

questions.question: What is the speaker's main warning about social media in the end?
options: A) It is too expensive to use
B) It is highly addictive, even in small doses
C) It will be banned soon
D) It is only for young people
questions.explanation: 原文中提到：'I think you'll realize how addicting it really is that five minutes here or there.'（你会意识到它有多容易上瘾，哪怕只是每次五分钟。）说话者警告说，即使只是短暂的碎片化使用，也会让人上瘾。

questions.question: What are the two levels of the challenge the speaker proposed? Please describe each level in your own words.
questions.explanation: 说话者提出了两级挑战：Level 1 是从下午5点开始到睡前不再刷手机（no scrolling between 5 p.m.），Level 2 是周日整天无手机（phone-free Sundays）。这是一个由易到难的递进式挑战。
questions.referenceAnswer: Level 1: No scrolling between 5 p.m. and bedtime. Level 2: Phone-free Sundays, meaning you don't use your phone at all on Sundays. The challenges progressively require more discipline and help you reduce phone dependence step by step.
questions.hint: Remember the two specific time rules mentioned by the speaker and explain what each requires you to do.

questions.question: According to the speaker, how does excessive social media use affect your relationships with family? Please give at least two specific impacts.
questions.explanation: 说话者从多个角度阐述了过度使用手机/社交媒体对家庭关系的影响：1）无法专注与家人交流（not listening when having conversation）；2）对伴侣、配偶、孩子缺乏耐心；3）不能全身心陪伴家人（not being present）；4）把注意力都给了手机而非身边的人。
questions.referenceAnswer: Excessive social media use affects family relationships in several ways: 1) You become less present with your family members; 2) You have less patience for your kids; 3) You may not listen carefully during conversations with your spouse; 4) It negatively impacts your partner and spouse as well. The speaker emphasizes that being constantly on your phone takes away from meaningful connections with loved ones.
questions.hint: Think about: presence, patience, listening, and how phone use affects the people around you.

questions.question: What hobbies or alternative activities does the speaker suggest to replace phone scrolling? Please list at least three suggestions.
questions.explanation: 说话者建议了多种替代活动：1）针织（knitting）、刺绣（embroidery）等手工类爱好，建议买套装入门；2）阅读（reading）、写日记（journals）；3）运动健身，比如下班前锻炼（work out before work）；4）散步（go for a walk）；5）与人面对面交流（conversation and connection）。
questions.referenceAnswer: The speaker suggests several alternatives: 1) Hobbies like knitting or embroidery, ideally started with a complete kit; 2) Reading books and journaling; 3) Physical activities like working out before work or going for a walk; 4) Spending time on outings and having face-to-face conversations with people. The key idea is to fill your time with meaningful, engaging activities that don't involve a screen.
questions.hint: Think about both creative hobbies and physical/outdoor activities she mentioned.

questions.question: What negative effects or symptoms did the speaker personally experience from overusing her phone? Please describe at least three.
questions.explanation: 说话者分享了她个人的负面体验：1）注意力无法集中（brain could not sit with something for a long period of time）；2）和丈夫聊天时不专心（not listening in conversation）；3）总想着跳到下一件事（jumping to the next thing）；4）一天结束时头疼（headaches at the end of the day）；5）认为自己的自律性足够强，但发现根本不够。
questions.referenceAnswer: The speaker experienced several negative effects: 1) Inability to focus on one thing for a long period - her brain constantly jumped to the next thing; 2) Not listening attentively during conversations with her husband; 3) Getting headaches at the end of each day, which she saw as a big red flag; 4) Discovering that her self-discipline was not as strong as she thought when it came to resisting social media. These experiences motivated her to set boundaries and find healthier alternatives.
questions.hint: Think about attention, conversations, physical symptoms, and self-awareness.
